name: e13-gnss-spoof
title: E13 · GNSS spoofing — the confidently-wrong failure
description: A spoofer induces a coherent false position (not random drift), so fixes taken in the belt are displaced with full confidence. Fused payload, everything on, 40 maps × 3 altitudes. A clean GNSS, B spoofed. Watch the ≤500 m hit rate collapse while the located count and 95%-ellipse calibration barely move — a tight ellipse is no defence against spoofing.
